title: Lesson 27 - I'm Not Sure That Will Work

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: The guide looks close. I'd like to send it to everyone on Friday morning.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I'm not sure that will work. The accessibility check won't be finished until Friday afternoon.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: My concern is that a Monday release will put us behind schedule.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: If we send it before the check, some staff may receive a file their screen reader can't use properly.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: That's a fair point. Is there any chance we could finish the check earlier?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Not carefully. We still have twelve pages and two file formats.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: What if we send it to a five-person review group on Thursday instead?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: That might work. The advantage is that we can test both files with a small group before the full release.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Will five people give us enough useful feedback?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Yes, if the group includes people using both file formats and different devices.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: If the reviewers reply by Friday noon, can we make the final changes that afternoon?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Yes. Then we can release it to everyone at nine on Monday.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I'd prefer that plan. It protects the check without losing another week.

lines.speaker: Marcus
lines.text: Agreed. Let's use the small review first and confirm the action items tomorrow.
